title: The f7 Hole
setup: Black has just taken your queen on h5, and f7 stands empty with its king still on e8.
hint: The black king has exactly one free square beside it. Which piece can attack it and check at once?
explanation:
## The Idea

Black's own pieces fill d7, d8 and f8, so f7 is the king's only square, and {{Bg6#}} covers f7 while checking straight through it. The rook that just took your queen is one square from stopping this and cannot come back in time.
